flags: The saved Virginia Byways list contains no route table. The catalog’s March 8, 1993 designation, full corridor and designation rationale cannot be independently supported; omitted from public copy.
The named auto trail, novel and present numbered roads share a name; the cache does not prove that the entire modern catalog corridor follows the auto trail.
Strip towns cover only the eastern section and do not give moment mileages. Retained Norton–Big Stone Gap sequence precedes the northbound Pound Gap branch; this requires returning north on US 23.

No unsupported current factual claims found apart from treating Norton’s census ranking as undated current information; now anchored to 2020. St. Paul’s founding, June Morris and Boone’s gap name were omitted for focus.
The Route 160 tractor-trailer restriction has only secondary cached support, not a current VDOT notice. The practical check date records cache review, not field verification.
The overview omits a single trip length and drive time because the cache does not establish them for this branched corridor.
Norton remains 73 words because the focused naming story is simple; other cached historical claims have questionable chronology and were not used to pad it.
